# Brand Safety Checklist

## Placement and context
- Placement categories and exclusions are defined.
- Publisher/creator context has been reviewed.
- Ad adjacency and user-generated content risks are considered.
- Audience suitability has been assessed.

## Content and claims
- Claims are accurate and substantiated.
- Disclosures and sponsorship labels are clear.
- Rights and permissions are documented.
- Sensitive topics and current context are reviewed.

## Operations
- Monitoring owner and escalation route are assigned.
- Incident response thresholds are documented.
- Review date and approval are recorded.

Use this checklist proportionately and document the rationale for exceptions.
